messages:
zoe: noticing a p95 tail jump in canary after last optimizer tweak, up from ~95ms -> ~410ms. kv hit rate down ~2x. No user errors yet but tail is bad. deploy-bot queued autorevert (low confidence).

deploy-bot: ALERT: p95 threshold breach. Suggested action: autorevert -> v2.7.0 (confidence 0.54). Autorevert will execute in 80s unless suppressed.

mike-oncall: suppress autorevert. We need traces and heap snapshots before pulling the change — revert could mask a transient. Ria, can you grab traces+kv stats?

ria-ops: running `rdwctl collect --scope canary --kinds traces,kv-stats,proc-samples --window 6m --out s3://rdw-dumps/1745556666-canary-snap.tar.gz` 

cs-amy: tagging CS. No customer reports yet but I'll prep a short proactive blurb if we escalate.

zoe: pinning rollout and adding manual hold: `releases pin --cohort canary --to v2.7.0 --reason "canary p95 spike; manual hold for traces"` 44d done.

eng-docs: note for release notes: record that autorevert was suppressed by oncall for signal preservation.

ria-ops: snapshot uploaded to s3://rdw-dumps/1745556666-canary-snap.tar.gz. Quick flamegraphs show increased memcpy in allocator path and repeated cold misses for hotspot keyset. Suspect allocator + eviction combo.

mike-oncall: propose rollback criteria: (A) if hotpatch unset of `experimental_allocator_v3` reduces p95 < 200ms within 10m -> resume; (B) immediate rollback to v2.6.9 if client error rate delta > 0.6% or p95 > 350ms for >15m. Also require CS notify if Dedicated customers appear in affected cohort.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert suppressed (actor: mike-oncall). To re-enable: `deploybot enable-autorevert --actor auto`

zoe: agree. Try hotpatch unset first: `opsctl patch kernelcfg --unset experimental_allocator_v3` then `rolling-restart --group canary --wait 50s`. Who owns restart?

ria-ops: I'll run the hotpatch and sequential restarts. Running now...

ria-ops: output: ```patch applied: experimental_allocator_v3 unset
restarting canary-1 ... ok
restarting canary-2 ... ok
restarting canary-3 ... ok
```

deploy-bot: MONITOR: p95 fell from 410ms -> 150ms across canary within 5m. Autorevert remains suppressed.

cs-amy: posting proactive customer note: "We paused a small internal rollout due to a performance regression and applied a hotfix; no customer impact observed."

mike-oncall: good recovery. Zoe, recommendation: unpin and resume a cautious rollout (10% -> 30% over 40m) with autorevert suppressed for another 45m to avoid flip. Also create rollback ticket if we need to escalate.

zoe: creating rollback ticket now: ops-RB-1745556666 (runbook attached). Postmortem owner: @zoe, draft due EOD.

eng-docs: I'll append a brief to the release notes: "Hotpatch revert applied to allocator flag due to canary p95 regression; rollout resumed under monitoring. Autorevert manually suppressed to preserve traces."

ria-ops: resuming rollout: `releases resume --cohort canary --to v2.7.1 --increment 5%/5m --max 30%` 44c resumed.

mike-oncall: I'll stay on watch for the next 60m and escalate to full rollback if criteria hit. Closing thread when postmortem link posted.
